neo_cpsam.method: Cellpose 4.0.5 pretrained cpsam segmentation with default eval parameters, followed by OrganoID-compatible and OrganoSeg2-style instance morphology measurements
neo_cpsam.fallback: none; retain masks and flag border-touching instances for review

zhengyu.display_name: DEO multiscale segmentation and metric pipeline
zhengyu.method: Original App81 density workflow: condition/day-aware multiscale Cellpose, signal-derived large-object candidates, overlap-aware candidate merge, and full metric backfill
zhengyu.fallback: original App81 signal-recovery candidates are merged using the original overlap-aware rules

y27632.method: Original App80 Y-27632 date-aware multiscale Cellpose and signal-based large-mass recovery pipeline
y27632.fallback: original App80 signal-recovery candidates are merged using the original overlap-aware rules

sodium_alginate.method: Original App65 sodium alginate condition/day-aware multiscale Cellpose and signal-based large-mass recovery pipeline
sodium_alginate.fallback: original App65 signal-recovery candidates are merged using the original overlap-aware rules

organoid_analysis.method: Agent-routed morphology and viability analysis. Use Cellpose-first morphology for brightfield morphology requests; use YOLO plus SAM as the morphology stage for viability requests, then run the existing viability model on its crop.

morphology.brightfield: POST /api/morphology/run with the selected files and the appropriate workflow_id: zhengyu, y27632, or sodium_alginate.
morphology.viability_roi: POST /api/fluorescence/run; this existing tool performs YOLO detection plus SAM segmentation and writes the existing crop, mask, overlay, and evidence outputs.

tools.viability: Use the existing /api/fluorescence/run workflow after YOLO+SAM ROI preparation.

routing: If the prompt asks for morphology, area, object count, density, growth, roundness, fusion, or condition/day comparison, use Cellpose morphology and preserve its existing QC/fallback/selection logic.
If the prompt asks for viability, live/dead activity, viability score, or activity ranking, use the existing YOLO+SAM plus viability workflow.
If the prompt asks for both, run both existing workflows on the selected inputs and report their outputs separately.

After results exist, interpret only measured values and segmentation evidence. If the user requests a table or chart, format the result table and call /api/charts/generate with the produced CSV or JSON and requested fields.
Do not replace Cellpose, signal recovery, YOLO, SAM, or the viability model with another algorithm.
organoid_analysis.fallback: none; report the exact failed tool and preserve any completed branch outputs

organoid_profiler.method: YOLO plus SAM segmentation followed by the repository-local 24-dimensional organoid profile. Pixel size is optional; omit it for pixel units or provide a positive physical length per pixel for scaled lengths and areas.
routing: Use only selected TIFF files from 06_OrganoidProfiler_49.
POST the selected files, optional pixel_size, and generate_charts=true when the user requests graphs to /api/organoid-profiler/run.
When other result tables need plots, use POST /api/charts/generate with the results CSV/JSON and requested metrics.
Do not use Cellpose or the viability checkpoint for this workflow.
Preserve per-image masks, overlays, crops, CSV, JSON, day/group growth rates, and requested chart files.
organoid_profiler.fallback: none; report the exact failed tool and preserve completed outputs

fluorescence.method: deterministic YOLO plus SAM segmentation and checkpoint-1 viability prediction
